precert.v: Failure to obtain preauthorization results in denial of benefits. Home health and skilled nursing instead carry a 20% reduction up to $500.

ambulance.v: $1,500 Maximum Payment after Deductible, in-network, for ground or air ambulance. Limited to 1 per family per benefit period. Out-of-network pays at the in-network level of benefits if emergent; non-emergent not covered.

dme.v: DME and supplies including prosthetics: $50 copayment after deductible, rental or purchase whichever is least costly. Precertification required at $500 or more. Limited to 5 visits combined.

er.v: $250 Copayment after Deductible, in-network. Limited to 2 per family per benefit period. Covers facility and professional services. Out-of-network pays at the in-network level of benefits if emergent; non-emergent visits are not covered.

home_health.v: $50 copayment after deductible, limited to 5 visits combined. Preauthorization required; without it benefits may be reduced 20% up to $500.

mental_health_inpatient.v: $250 copayment after deductible, limited to 5 days. Out-of-network not covered.

mental_health_outpatient.v: $50 copayment after deductible for office services, limited to 5 visits. Out-of-network not covered.

pcp.v: $40 copayment, waived if referred by Guardianship. Limited to 7 visits. Out-of-network not covered.

preventive.v: ACA-required preventive paid 100% in-network subject to age, gender and frequency limits. Outside those limits, and other non-ACA preventive, treated as any other illness. Out-of-network not covered.

rehab.v: $50 copayment after deductible, limited to 5 visits combined.

rx_brand.v: Preferred and non-preferred brand name drugs are NOT COVERED, in and out of network, retail and home delivery.

rx_generic.v: Preferred generic drugs: $12 copayment per 30-day retail supply. Out-of-network not covered.

rx_specialty.v: Preferred and non-preferred specialty drugs NOT COVERED. Patient assistance available through ScriptAide subject to foundational program rules including income requirements.

snf.v: $50 copayment after deductible, limited to 5 visits combined. Preauthorization required; without it benefits may be reduced 20% up to $500.

specialist.v: $50 copayment, waived if referred by Guardianship. Limited to 7 visits. Out-of-network not covered.

surgery_outpatient.v: $750 Copayment after Deductible, in-network. Limited to 2 per family per benefit period. Elective surgery is excluded - defined in the document as a procedure planned in advance that can be postponed without immediate harm. Out-of-network not covered.

telehealth.v: $0 copayment through the plan's preferred telemedicine platform for primary care, mental health and urgent care. Out-of-network not covered.

urgent_care.v: $60 copayment per visit, waived if referred by Guardianship. Limited to 3 visits. Out-of-network not covered.

xray.v: $75 copayment after deductible, limited to 2 per family per benefit period. Out-of-network not covered.

verification_script.v: A mandatory Post-Close Verification Script exists and must be read on a recorded line before the end of every enrollment call. Its confirmations, in order: (1) the agent will review important details and ask the client to confirm understanding after each statement; (2) this is a Group Limited Medical plan offered to working owners of Population Science Management, providing limited benefits for certain covered services, NOT major medical insurance, and it will not cover all healthcare expenses; (3) the client confirms willingness to share personal health and consumer insights data as a Working Owner in Population Science Management; (4) the plan does not provide full maternity coverage; (5) if the client or a dependent needs ongoing treatment, frequent doctor visits, or continuous management of a medical condition, this plan may not meet those needs; (6) only dependents specifically enrolled that day will be covered and anyone not listed will not have benefits; (7) the pre-existing conditions limitation; (8) the client confirms understanding that the plan provides limited medical benefits, is not major medical coverage, and that they enroll with full awareness of the plan's limits and exclusions; closing with 'Thank you. I will now complete your enrollment.'

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Assuming the variants differ only by deductible, or quoting one variant's visit limits while discussing another. The families are about 95% lexically identical and the copays genuinely are the same, which makes the differing limits easy to miss.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not carry a visit limit from one Smart Choice variant to another. Do not say the plans are 'the same except for the deductible'. Do not quote a limit without first confirming which exact variant the client is on.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: These plans differ by more than the deductible. The copays are the same across all four, but the number of visits you get changes - this plan gives you [N] primary care visits a year, and the higher-deductible versions give you fewer.

source.sec: 20, 19 - Benefit Summary pages 6-9 of each, extracted variant by variant

compliance_risks.verified_fact: Visit limits DECREASE as the deductible increases across this family. Primary care is 12 visits on the 1500, 10 on the 2500, 7 on the 3000 and 5 on the 3500. Inpatient day caps run 7, 5, 4 and 3. Copay AMOUNTS are identical across all four variants; only the limits move.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Before quoting ANY visit or day limit on a Smart Choice plan, confirm the exact variant.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Saying 'prescriptions are covered' or quoting the $12 copay without disclosing that brand and specialty drugs are excluded entirely. Also describing ScriptAide as prescription coverage - it is a patient-assistance program with income requirements, not insurance.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not say 'prescriptions are covered'. Do not quote the $12 copay alone. Do not describe ScriptAide as coverage or imply it guarantees access to a specialty drug.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Generic prescriptions are covered at a $12 copay for a 30-day supply. Brand-name and specialty drugs are not covered by this plan at all. There is a patient assistance program for specialty drugs, but it is not insurance and it depends on income eligibility.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Preferred and non-preferred BRAND NAME drugs are NOT COVERED, in and out of network, at retail and by home delivery. Specialty drugs are NOT COVERED. Only preferred generics are covered, at a $12 copayment for a 30-day retail supply. Specialty access is via ScriptAide patient assistance, subject to income requirements.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Always, and specifically before answering any question about a named medication.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Softening this. Maternity is a total exclusion on this family, not a limited benefit.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not say maternity is 'limited' or 'has a waiting period'. Do not cite the postpartum depression screening as evidence of maternity coverage.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: This plan does not cover pregnancy, maternity or newborn care at all. If that is something you need, this is not the right plan for you.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Pregnancy, maternity and newborn care are NOT COVERED, in and out of network. Dependent child pregnancy is specifically not covered. Infertility diagnosis and treatment are not covered. The plan does pay 100% for one initial postpartum depression screening within a year of pregnancy or childbirth.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Always when a client is of childbearing age or asks about family planning.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Answering an exclusions question, a pre-existing question or a definitional question about these two variants from the document in hand. That document does not contain the answer.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not quote any exclusion, pre-existing provision, waiting period, or definition of hospital, sickness, injury or confinement for Smart Choice 3000 or 3500 from the current documents. A variant documented only to its benefit summary gives amounts but no exclusions.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing. Route the question to the certificate.

source.sec: verified page count 13 versus 81 for the complete document

compliance_risks.verified_fact: The plan documents held for these two variants are 13-page truncated exports. The Exclusions and Definitions sections are absent, though their own tables of contents reference them.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Any question that is not a benefit amount or a visit limit.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Classifying any product from its name. Doing so produces errors in both directions - calling insurance a membership, and calling a service a discount.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never type or describe a product from its name. Read the Info page.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing client-facing. This is an internal rule.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Product names in this portfolio are unreliable indicators of product type IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. 'AWA SimpleShield Membership Plan' is fixed indemnity insurance. 'Prime Health Pass Discount' is described on its own page as a Diagnostic Services Product delivering services. Between April and September NEO inserted the word 'Membership' into four Safe Guard product names without any evident change of type. Meanwhile 'AssistPro Discount' genuinely is a discount program.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Before any add-on is described on a call, and before any tooling assigns it a category.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Paraphrasing it. This project's own standard is that verbatim script accuracy is required and approximate wording is a compliance violation - and the canonical text of the required script is not in the knowledge base at all, so there is nothing to check a paraphrase against.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not paraphrase, compress or reorder the confirmations. Do not skip the data-sharing confirmation because it sounds unusual - it is how the client becomes eligible.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: The script itself is the safe wording. It should be read as written.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: A mandatory Post-Close Verification Script must be read on a recorded line before the end of every SmartChoice enrollment call. It exists ONLY inside a TalentLMS course unit - not in any plan document, portal page, brochure or Drive file.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Two opposite errors are live here, and both are serious. An agent reading the script is telling a client the plan has a pre-existing limitation that cannot be substantiated from the plan document. An agent working from the plan document could tell a client there is no pre-existing limitation - which contradicts what they are required to say on the recorded line.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client SmartChoice has no pre-existing condition limitation. Do not state a look-back or exclusion period - no source held states one, including the plan documents the script itself points to.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing beyond the script itself. Read the script as written, and if the client asks how long the pre-existing period lasts, say you will confirm it in writing rather than quoting a number.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: CONFLICT, UNRESOLVED. The mandatory verification script states the plan includes limitations on pre-existing conditions. The complete 81-page plan document - including its full Exclusions and Definitions sections - and the live NEO portal page contain NO pre-existing language at all.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Any pre-existing question on SmartChoice, and before the script is next revised.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Reading the scripted line and letting the client infer partial maternity coverage exists. 'Not full coverage' is what someone says about a plan that covers some maternity. This plan covers none.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not leave 'not full maternity coverage' unqualified. Do not describe maternity as limited or partial on this family.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: This plan does not cover pregnancy, maternity or newborn care at all. If that is something you need, this is not the right plan for you.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The verification script says the plan 'does not provide full maternity coverage'. The plan document shows Pregnancy, Maternity and Newborn Care as Not Covered in-network AND out-of-network, with dependent child pregnancy specifically not covered.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Any call with a client of childbearing age, and whenever the scripted line is read.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Selling this as ordinary individual coverage. It is group coverage the client qualifies for by becoming a working owner of a data company and agreeing to share personal health data. An agent who cannot explain that cannot explain what the client is signing. Also: 'must qualify for employment by completing health and eligibility questions' indicates medical underwriting at enrollment - so a client may be declined.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not describe SmartChoice as individual coverage. Do not skip or soften the data-sharing confirmation. Do not tell a client enrolment is guaranteed - there are health and eligibility questions.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: This is a group plan through Population Science Management. You qualify by becoming what they call a working owner, which means agreeing to share some personal health and consumer information with them. There are health and eligibility questions to answer as part of enrolling.

source.sec: units 'The Working Owner Model' and 'Enrollment Requirements'

compliance_risks.verified_fact: Eligibility runs through the Working Owner model. SmartChoice is an employer-sponsored group plan provided by Population Science Management, a data research and analytics company. The client becomes a Working Owner by acting as a Consumer Data Respondent, sharing personal health and consumer-habit data. The verification script requires the client to confirm willingness to share that data on a recorded line. Enrollment also requires health and eligibility questions, a valid SSN for the owner/operator and all dependents, and a spousal signature where applicable.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Every SmartChoice call, before quoting anything.

For those products the NEO reference page is the only available source, and four of those pages carry a limitations or exclusions heading with no text beneath it.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client a scheduled benefit amount will be paid in full without qualifying it by the URC limit.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Every recorded verification must cover all four elements. Omitting the recurring monthly amount or the automatic draft is a breach of the platform agreement, not only a compliance risk.

compliance_risks.verified_fact: Neo Insurance Solutions is an agency and platform, not the insurer, and disclaims liability for agents' conduct and representations.

compliance_risks.verified_fact: The storefront serves two different versions of the NEO enrolment agreement. The shorter one, on the MDLive pages, omits the 3.5% processing fee, the contact and electronic-document consents, the HIPAA statement and the member signature block.

enrollment_mechanics.v: Enrollment requirements: the applicant must qualify for employment by completing health and eligibility questions; a valid Social Security Number is required for the owner/operator and all dependents; a spousal signature is required at enrollment where applicable; coverage is 1st-of-the-month effective with an enrollment cutoff of the 23rd of the month; all P2 payments are processed on the 20th of the month.

administration.plan_changes.v: Plan change rules: dependents can be removed at any time but cannot be re-added without a Qualifying Life Event; dependents cannot be added and plans cannot be changed outside of a QLE or Open Enrollment; plan changes outside Open Enrollment require proof of QLE and must be submitted within 60 days. Examples of acceptable QLE proof given include a birth or adoption certificate and a lease or mortgage showing a permanent address change.

administration.vendors.v: Green Imaging for imaging orders, DiaThrive for diabetic supplies, ConnectDME for durable medical equipment. GuideCM for precertification and case management; NaviClaim for member advocacy.

benefits.advanced_imaging.v: CT, MRI, MRA, MRS, PET, SPECT and other nuclear medicine: $250 copayment after deductible, limited to 2 per benefit period. Out-of-network not covered.

benefits.all_other.v: All other covered services subject to deductible and coinsurance in-network. Out-of-network not covered.

benefits.allergy.v: Testing limited to 2 visits at $50 copayment; shots limited to 8 visits at $25 copayment.

benefits.colorectal_screening.v: Screening starts at age 45. Colonoscopy and sigmoidoscopy/proctoscopy/CT colonography 100% once every five years; FIT DNA once every three years; fecal occult blood test once per year. Outside limits, treated as any other illness.

benefits.diabetic_services.v: Diabetic counselling, education, self-management training and podiatric appliances: $50 copayment after deductible, limited to 1 visit. Supplies through DiaThrive only.

benefits.home_infusion.v: $150 copayment after deductible, limited to 8 visits combined, maximum combined with chemotherapy and radiation. Hospital-based treatment not covered.

benefits.hospice.v: $50 copayment after deductible, limited to 5 visits combined.

benefits.immunizations.v: Paid 100% in-network for pediatric up to age 7 and for age 7 and older. Illness-related immunizations treated as any other illness.

benefits.inpatient_hospital.v: $2,500 copayment after deductible. Limited to 1 per family per benefit period for up to 4 days. Out-of-network not covered.

benefits.outpatient_drugs_administered.v: Drugs administered in an outpatient setting: $50 copayment after deductible, limited to 5 visits combined.

benefits.physician_office_services.v: $40 copayment, waived if referred by Guardianship, with or without an office visit. Out-of-network not covered.

benefits.prescriptions.formulary.v: 30-day retail benefit runs on the Ventegra Acute Formulary only.

benefits.prescriptions.home_delivery.v: Preferred generic drugs by 90-day home delivery through ScriptCo. Brand drugs not covered.

benefits.therapy_manipulations.v: $50 copayment after deductible, limited to 5 visits combined. Therapy limits do not apply to mental health or substance use disorder treatment. Evaluations covered and excluded from the combined annual limit.

cost_sharing.accumulator_rule.v: In-network and out-of-network deductibles and out-of-pocket limits are separate and do not cross-accumulate. All other limits do cross-accumulate.

cost_sharing.deductible.individual.v: $3,000 in-network per calendar year. Out-of-network: Not Covered.

eligibility.working_owner_model.v: SmartChoice is described as an employer-sponsored GROUP plan provided by Population Science Management (PSM). PSM is a data research and analytics company whose stated mission is empowering individuals to earn money by sharing their personal data and providing Working Owners access to Group Benefit Plans. PSM employs Consumer Data Respondents (CDRs) who provide insights into their health and consumer habits; as a CDR, each person is recognised as a Working Owner of PSM. The material positions this as a solution for working owners, 1099 self-employed and gig-economy workers.

limitations.elective_surgery.v: Elective surgery excluded from the outpatient hospital or facility benefit.

limitations.infertility.v: Diagnosis of infertility and treatment to promote fertility both NOT COVERED.

limitations.maternity.v: Pregnancy, maternity and newborn care NOT COVERED in and out of network. Dependent child pregnancy specifically not covered. Plan pays 100% for an initial postpartum depression screening within one year of pregnancy or childbirth.

limitations.out_of_network.v: Out-of-network shown as Not Covered on every Benefit Summary line except emergency room and emergency transportation, which pay at in-network level when emergent.

training.curriculum_structure.v: The TalentLMS course 'SmartChoice' (Product category, courseId 202) contains a dedicated unit per variant - SmartChoice 3500, 3000, 2500 and 1500 - plus units titled 'The Working Owner Model', 'Additional Benefits', 'Enrollment Requirements' and 'Test Your Knowledge'. Unit contents were not opened.
